title: Petition of Deacon Transportation, Inc. for a 120-day temporary license, pursuant to G.L. c. 159A, § 5, for the operation of motor vehicles for the carriage of passengers for hire over certain public ways in the City of Boston and under the jurisdiction of the Massachusetts Turnpike Authority and the Metropolitan District Commission, restricted to the hotel personnel, patrons, guests and invitees of the Boston Marriott Hotel/Long Wharf.
